content.short: Gitcoin is a leading decentralized platform focused on funding and building open-source software communities.
content.description: Gitcoin is a foundational decentralized protocol designed to support the development and funding of public goods and open-source software. Through its innovative Quadratic Funding mechanism, Gitcoin ensures that community contributions are matched with institutional funding in a way that prioritizes projects with the broadest community support. The platform features a suite of tools for project discovery, bounty management, and hackathon organization, fostering a vibrant and collaborative ecosystem for developers. Gitcoin's commitment to decentralization and community-driven governance makes it a critical pillar of the Web3 landscape, empowering creators to build a more open, inclusive, and rewarding digital future.
content.meta: Gitcoin is the leading platform for funding open-source projects, utilizing Quadratic Funding to build and support Web3 public goods.

resources.title: Identity Infrastructure: The Binding Constraint on Democratic Funding
resources.tldr: Every one-person-one-vote funding scheme decays without Sybil resistance, and allocation math has raced ahead of any ability to verify who is voting.

resources.title: The Grantee-to-Funder Flywheel: How Early Public Goods Funding Seeds Future Funders
resources.tldr: Follows specific chains of causation: Plasma Group's modest QF grant to Optimism's 60M+ OP distribution, 1inch's $50K to $3M given back.

resources.title: Mechanism Pluralism: Why No Single Funding Model Works
resources.tldr: Cross-ecosystem analysis arguing one dominant funding mechanism is as brittle as one crop. The case for a portfolio of mechanisms, not the single best.
